slug: 2024-09-24 Egypt deploys automated civil-registry kiosks (birth certificates and national ID)

facts.fact: The Ministry of Interior's civil-registry kiosks, at 16 locations in 2024, have users enter their national-ID number and confirm identity by fingerprint or facial recognition before issuing documents.

EGY.note: The kiosks issue certificates and ID application forms, but no exchange of records between the registers is stated.
No count or share is given.
No number at birth is mentioned.
The kiosks take national-ID applications, but the document does not say who operates or maintains the ID system.
No public register keyed on the ID number is mentioned.
The document names no national ID system's operation or deduplication; kiosk biometric confirmation is not stated to stop double enrolment.
